name: West Nile virus system
transmission_pathway: mosquito-mediated enzootic cycle with human infection as a distinct endpoint
environment_or_host_interface: Culex/vector, bird-host, human, and seasonal environmental interfaces
geographic_scale: state/county/program; human case geography may be residence
notes: Included as a distinct vector-borne surveillance system; positive pools, human cases, infection, and local transmission remain separate; a vector record is not a human infection and is not local transmission.

name: Lyme disease system
pathogen_or_agent: Borrelia burgdorferi sensu lato; Ixodes scapularis interface
transmission_pathway: tick-mediated transmission with human case surveillance as a separate stream
environment_or_host_interface: Ixodes, forest/edge, vertebrate hosts, and human interface
geographic_scale: county/state; case surveillance commonly uses residence geography
notes: Uses accepted Phase 12 tick ecology context without reconstructing vector abundance or human exposure location.

name: Legionellosis system
pathogen_or_agent: Legionella bacteria; Legionnaires' disease and Pontiac fever
transmission_pathway: inhalation of aerosolized water or droplets; generally not person-to-person
environment_or_host_interface: building water systems, cooling/aerosol interfaces, and healthcare settings
notes: A building-water pathway is not a contamination, treatment-failure, exposure, infection, or illness finding by itself.

name: Waterborne enteric disease system
pathogen_or_agent: multiple enteric agents including norovirus, Giardia, Cryptosporidium, and bacteria
transmission_pathway: ingestion, contact, or other water-associated pathways established through investigation
environment_or_host_interface: drinking water, recreational water, and environmental water interfaces
notes: Retained as a distinct multi-agent system; no nutrient, bloom, indicator, or infrastructure-age-to-illness inference is made.

name: Salmonella infection system
transmission_pathway: foodborne, environmental, animal-contact, and person-to-person pathways
environment_or_host_interface: food, clinical laboratory, animal, and outbreak-investigation interfaces
notes: Kept distinct from Campylobacter, STEC, and outbreak records; it is not a composite disease-risk score and no composite enteric burden is created.

name: Campylobacter infection system
transmission_pathway: foodborne and other enteric pathways
environment_or_host_interface: food, clinical laboratory, and state/territorial laboratory interfaces
notes: FoodNet/LEDS/NNDSS system context is retained without treating surveillance coverage as all community infections.

name: Shiga toxin-producing E. coli system
transmission_pathway: foodborne, water/environmental, animal-contact, and person-to-person pathways
environment_or_host_interface: food, animal, water, clinical laboratory, and outbreak interfaces
notes: STEC O157 and non-O157 distinctions remain source-dependent; no illness or exposure location is inferred.

name: Seasonal influenza system
transmission_pathway: respiratory transmission with laboratory, outpatient, hospital, and mortality observation streams
environment_or_host_interface: community, healthcare, laboratory, and sentinel-provider interfaces
notes: Included as a surveillance-system example, not a single transmission-rate or pandemic reconstruction.

name: SARS-CoV-2 community surveillance system
transmission_pathway: respiratory transmission with wastewater and clinical surveillance interfaces
environment_or_host_interface: community/sewershed, laboratory, healthcare, and public-health interfaces
notes: Wastewater is an observation stream; it does not supply an infection count, individual exposure estimate, or risk surface.

name: Rabies system
transmission_pathway: animal bite/scratch or saliva exposure with human and animal endpoints distinct
environment_or_host_interface: wildlife, domestic animal, animal-control, laboratory, and PEP interfaces
notes: Animal infection, potential exposure, PEP, human infection, and human disease remain separate records.

name: Healthcare-associated infection system
transmission_pathway: healthcare-associated acquisition and facility surveillance pathways
environment_or_host_interface: healthcare facilities, infection prevention, laboratory, and public reporting interfaces
notes: Generalized HAI system only; no facility ranking, performance score, patient data, or community-incidence inference.

name: Antimicrobial-resistance surveillance system
transmission_pathway: resistance detection and healthcare/community surveillance pathways
environment_or_host_interface: clinical laboratory, healthcare, public-health laboratory, and response interfaces
notes: Generalized AR surveillance context only; national threat estimates are not Western Basin observations.

name: HAB toxic/noninfectious boundary
pathogen_or_agent: cyanobacterial toxins and other HAB-associated hazards
transmission_pathway: toxic/environmental pathways kept separate from infection
environment_or_host_interface: source water, recreational water, monitoring, and treatment interfaces
notes: HAB context is not placed in the infectious-disease pathogen set; contamination, toxin exposure, and illness remain separate; it is not a disease-risk index and is not a risk surface.

name: NNDSS case-surveillance interface
transmission_pathway: case reporting from state, local, tribal, and territorial health departments
environment_or_host_interface: healthcare, laboratory, public-health, and jurisdictional reporting
notes: NNDSS collects case-surveillance data; disease-specific definitions and completeness are not interchangeable.

name: State and local reportable-disease systems
transmission_pathway: provider, laboratory, and public-health reporting
environment_or_host_interface: state/local health departments, hospitals, laboratories, and reporting forms
notes: Ohio, Michigan, and Indiana reporting systems are retained as jurisdictional interfaces; no uniform three-state denominator is assumed.

name: ArboNET and mosquito surveillance interface
pathogen_or_agent: West Nile virus and other arbovirus vector/animal/human streams
transmission_pathway: mosquito trapping, pooled testing, animal and human reporting
environment_or_host_interface: agency/county/state
notes: Reuses Phase 12 vector context; vector detection, pathogen-positive pools, human infection, and cases remain separate.

name: Legionellosis surveillance interface
transmission_pathway: case reporting and supplemental exposure/source information
environment_or_host_interface: jurisdiction/national; investigation-specific setting
notes: CDC describes two national surveillance systems and reports provisional periods; this package does not reconstruct case counts.

name: Waterborne and foodborne outbreak reporting
transmission_pathway: epidemiologic investigation and outbreak reporting
environment_or_host_interface: state/local/territorial outbreak and exposure setting
notes: Outbreak reporting requires an investigation context; it is not a continuous incidence denominator.

name: National enteric laboratory and case surveillance
pathogen_or_agent: Campylobacter, Salmonella, Shigella, STEC and other enteric conditions
transmission_pathway: clinical and public-health laboratory reporting plus case-based surveillance
environment_or_host_interface: state/territorial public-health laboratory and NNDSS/SEDRIC
notes: Laboratory-identified infections and case records do not capture all infections or identify exposure location by default.

name: FoodNet active surveillance interface
transmission_pathway: active communication with clinical laboratories and detailed infection follow-up
environment_or_host_interface: FoodNet surveillance area / ten state health departments
notes: FoodNet coverage and post-2025 reporting changes make it complementary to, not interchangeable with, NNDSS/LEDS.

name: FluView and influenza surveillance components
transmission_pathway: laboratory, outpatient, hospitalization, mortality, and other reporting streams
environment_or_host_interface: national/HHS region/state and sentinel stream
notes: Testing, sentinel outpatient, hospital, and mortality streams have distinct denominators and interpretations.

name: CDC wastewater monitoring
pathogen_or_agent: SARS-CoV-2 and other tracked respiratory viruses
transmission_pathway: sewershed wastewater sampling and viral measurement
environment_or_host_interface: sewershed/community/state/regional/national
notes: Community-level observation and early warning are not an infection count, incidence rate, or individual risk measure.

name: Animal rabies and human PEP interface
transmission_pathway: animal testing, exposure assessment, and post-exposure prophylaxis
environment_or_host_interface: animal-control/veterinary/public-health and exposure investigation
notes: Animal test results and PEP are response records; neither is substituted for human infection or disease burden.

name: NHSN healthcare-associated infection surveillance
transmission_pathway: facility reporting and standardized HAI measures
environment_or_host_interface: facility/state/regional/national
notes: The system supports facility and public-health reporting; participation is not a community denominator.

name: Antimicrobial-resistance observation/response interface
transmission_pathway: clinical laboratory and public-health surveillance
environment_or_host_interface: facility/state/regional/national
notes: Retained at generalized system level; no local AR prevalence or facility ranking is generated.

name: Drinking and recreational water interface
transmission_pathway: ingestion/contact/aerosol pathways requiring evidence
environment_or_host_interface: source water, finished water, recreational water, and investigation setting
notes: Source-water condition, treatment, exposure, infection, and reported illness remain separate states.

name: Building water and aerosol interface
transmission_pathway: aerosol/droplet inhalation and healthcare/building-water interface
environment_or_host_interface: building water systems, cooling/aerosol, healthcare
notes: No building-specific sampling, contamination, exposure, or illness claim is made.

name: Food, animal, and environmental interface
pathogen_or_agent: enteric pathogens and rabies virus as separate systems
transmission_pathway: foodborne, animal-contact, environmental, and bite/scratch pathways
environment_or_host_interface: food chain, wildlife/domestic animals, laboratories, and investigations
notes: The shared interface does not merge unlike pathogens or assert a common burden.

name: Respiratory community and wastewater interface
pathogen_or_agent: influenza, SARS-CoV-2, and other tracked respiratory viruses
transmission_pathway: respiratory transmission observed through clinical and wastewater systems
environment_or_host_interface: community, sewershed, laboratory, outpatient, and hospital interfaces
notes: Wastewater, testing, hospitalization, and case reports are complementary streams, not one transmission rate.

name: Population and settlement interface
transmission_pathway: human presence, activity, care-seeking, and reporting interface
environment_or_host_interface: settlement, workplace, mobility, household, and healthcare context
notes: Reuses Phase 11 at native scale; population presence does not establish contact, exposure, infection, or disease.

name: Public-health laboratory and reporting interface
pathogen_or_agent: clinical, environmental, animal, and vector specimens
transmission_pathway: testing, laboratory confirmation, electronic reporting, and case classification
environment_or_host_interface: laboratory/state/local/territorial/national
notes: Laboratory and reporting systems observe selected events; testing intensity is not disease intensity.

name: Public-health response and decision interface
transmission_pathway: investigation, communication, treatment/referral, control, and prevention
environment_or_host_interface: agency/program/jurisdiction/healthcare
notes: Monitoring, advice, funding, and information are kept distinct from operational control and legal authority.

name: Accepted Phase 7A exposure context reference
transmission_pathway: accepted environmental-health evidence ladder
environment_or_host_interface: water, air, soil, food, recreation, and heat context
geographic_scale: Western Basin / pathway and monitoring scale
notes: Reference only; Phase 7A artifacts are protected and not rebuilt or modified.

name: Accepted Phase 9 climate context reference
transmission_pathway: accepted physical-environmental context
environment_or_host_interface: station, county, watershed, shoreline, lake, and regional context
notes: Reference only; no disease suitability, incidence, or causal attribution is derived.

name: Accepted Phase 11 population context reference
pathogen_or_agent: population, settlement, workplace, and mobility context
transmission_pathway: accepted aggregate population context
environment_or_host_interface: county, place, generalized employment, and mobility scales
notes: Reference only; no individual movement or local disease downscaling is created.

name: Accepted Phase 12 vector ecology context reference
pathogen_or_agent: vector taxa, pathogen-in-vector, habitat, and surveillance context
transmission_pathway: accepted vector ecology and surveillance relationships
environment_or_host_interface: county, habitat, program, and generalized ecology scales
notes: Reference only; vector detection != pathogen-positive vector != human infection.

name: Accepted Phase 4 observation context reference
transmission_pathway: accepted observation-to-decision context
environment_or_host_interface: station, program, agency, and information-chain scales
notes: Reference only; monitoring coverage is heterogeneous and is not complete surveillance.

name: Accepted Phase 10 governance context reference
transmission_pathway: accepted institutional-role distinctions
environment_or_host_interface: agency/program/jurisdictional scales
notes: Reference only; governance roles are not collapsed into response performance or vulnerability.
